deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'mkdir -p /home/node/.openclaw && node openclaw.mjs config set gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins "[\"https://openclaw-production-56fa.up.railway.app\"]" && node openclaw.mjs config set gateway.controlUi.dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth true && { ( sleep 25; echo AGENT_SELFTEST_START; timeout 120 node openclaw.mjs agent --local --message "Reply with exactly the single word PONG and nothing else" 2>&1; echo AGENT_SELFTEST_EXIT=$?; echo AGENT_SELFTEST_END ) & } && exec node openclaw.mjs gateway --allow-unconfigured --bind lan --port 8080'
